verdict.rationale: YPOG publishes plain-language insight briefings covering formation (notary starterkit/GmbH foundation questionnaire), financing (seedstrapping/CLA/SAFE explainer), and equity (multiple ESOP/VSOP tax briefings), all on its own public site. Missing for 10: a single consolidated 'knowledge base' or FAQ-style hub (these are scattered insight posts/downloads rather than an organized library) and independent evidence of usage/reception.
